name: product_error_read_v14
purpose: TASKS 246 (e) (design note of 26 Oct 2026, section 14; README decision 65, amendment of 16 Nov 2026): the licence's quantity - the error of the corrected band positions of the seeds' mean dH - for the three v1.4 candidates of chain v14_data (the carried recipe on the whole pool), on hold-outs (a) and (b) as their evaluation records eval_data_seed* list them, before the version is carried. Read with --models and --records, so the record says 'candidate' and lies beside the candidates under out/v14, not under the carried version's record name. No --package: the package's record is version 1.3's. Launch after chain v14_data has written its evals; the whole-pool checkpoints are named n1082 (the pool before two hold-out twins are dropped) - if the trainer named them otherwise the read stops with 'no such file' and this command is corrected.

estimate.basis: the carried version's read took 102 s on 16 Nov 2026 (product_error_read: 47 stored molecules, three checkpoints loaded per molecule); this one reads hold-out (a) whole, 49 molecules

memory.basis: max RSS 1.94 GB of a 249-molecule evaluation on 16 Nov 2026 (v14_seleval_smoke); this read holds one molecule at a time
